## Governance metadata

- **PR class**: feature
- **Task ID(s)**: M1-009
- **Risk tier**: R2
- **Accountable owner**: @Chengyue-Lu
- **Workstream**: docs/workstreams/chengyue-lu/M1-PROJECT-SCAFFOLD

## Scope and non-goals

`rwb init` now creates a reusable no-Skill project with a local Task/Profile, explicit Runtime pin and project metadata. `--template offline-demo` adds the existing bounded integer Run example; `--template minimal` preserves the earlier entry. `rwb project check PATH` validates the explicit project and installed resource binding. Initialization refuses existing contents and linked paths, stages complete output, and executes no research code.

Versioned template assets are included in both distribution routes. The existing dual-Python package smoke now initializes the project, checks its pins, reconstructs the offline Run in a fresh process and validates its report. CLI/Schema 0.x compatibility and migration/deprecation rules are documented; README and Getting Started consume the implemented no-Skill input path.

M14-004 remains READY for its final Quickstart integration and R2 acceptance; M14-005 remains BLOCKED. Runtime catalog classes, published Schema/Registry identities, release surface policy and Human/Claim authority are unchanged. No release branch, tag or real release is created.

## Contract and authority impact

- **Shared contract**: yes
- **Authority impact**: no

The shared CLI gains reusable templates and an explicit project check. R2 is declared because the package smoke is under `.github/`; coverage policy adds the scaffold suite and retains the existing thresholds and required adversarial evidence.

## TASKS transition

M1-009: READY -> DONE. The original Task definition, hard dependency M1-006, owner and acceptance are retained. This PR proposes completion for named-owner acceptance; it does not complete M14-004 or activate M14-005.

## Verification evidence

M1-009 implementation commits: `adda5fc` (scaffold/CLI/versioned template assets and regressions) and `17d1c42` (dual-route installed verification, compatibility/docs and retained evidence). Base: `develop@60bdf8c` including accepted PR #71 after #73/#69; the only rebase conflict in STATUS retains both accepted M5-006 and scaffold wording. Archive: `work/M1-009/A-20260912-001`.

Initial local evidence below was captured on the pre-#71 baseline; the frozen archive retains that identity. The successful pre-rebase hosted run `34690750933` is historical, and current-candidate results come from run `34691371796`.

- CLI/scaffold: 22 PASS + 1 Windows symlink skip; dedicated scaffold suite 11 PASS + the same skip.
- Scaffold module coverage: 100% line / 100% branch after adding the new-destination replacement-failure check. This is module-local evidence, not global coverage.
- Documentation/public-surface/governance/package/coverage-policy tests: 130 PASS.
- Repository validation: 186 documents, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Python 3.11.16/3.13.15 direct wheel and sdist-to-wheel: 8 isolated/poisoned installations PASS, all scaffold reconstructions matched; 124 Runtime resources, 76 Schemas, 4 Modes and 0 Projections. Resource closures match across distribution routes.
- Trace validation: no BLOCK; native capture-gap warning retained. An initial archive path-validation failure and its correction are preserved.
- Current head: `b33e145d0524d1e9f2a32ddf696d3c08907e96c2`, base `60bdf8c28f6cf8c52c04e481e0309bbd6e8cba8b`. [Current-candidate CI run 34691371796](https://github.com/Chengyue-Lu/research-agent-workbench/actions/runs/34691371796) completed successfully: full behavior, impact + repository coverage, both package routes on Python 3.11/3.13, repository smoke, documentation and both final test gates. Current-head governance also passes.
- Hosted full results: Python 3.11 and 3.13 each 1225/1225 PASS. Python 3.11 reuses the measured ordered execution under the accepted proof contract; coverage evidence includes 1199 coverage cases. Both full result artifacts bind plan `676570e3059ae9d4cf7df47434ffc6256289f445a039654c85a8b2924a43233a` and merge target `ee41c654d965aa3f3fb5338230a37cb862255ba4`.
- Hosted scaffold coverage: 137/137 lines and 40/40 branches (100% / 100%). The repository policy reports global line coverage 93.76% against its unchanged 90% floor; impact and repository obligations both pass.
- Post-rebase local checks: 130 focused tests PASS, scaffold 11 PASS + 1 Windows symlink skip, repository validation 186/0/0, Trace no BLOCK and whitespace checks PASS. The frozen archive remains historical evidence with its original identity.
- Frozen Windows archive bytes retain their original hashes. A narrowly scoped `cr-at-eol` attribute permits CRLF while retaining the other standard whitespace checks; a local negative probe still rejects actual trailing spaces.

## Residual risk and follow-up

The example is a synthetic engineering fixture, not a real scientific result. Its initializing-interpreter environment is explicitly rebound, and reproduction is trusted code execution rather than an OS sandbox. Legacy projects can keep their existing validation/checkpoint flow; automatic project upgrades are not implemented. M14-004 final Quickstart acceptance, licensing, remote protections and named Human release decision remain separate.

## Authority basis

Accepted M1-009 was READY with M1-006 DONE. The user authorized merging PR #73/#69 and then advancing M1-009. Chengyue-Lu owns the project semantics and requests cross-owner R2 review from let778750-cpu. Scientific Claim acceptance, Provider/live conformance, Skill admission and release authority remain with their existing owners and gates.

## Adversarial evidence

Tests reject nonempty/file/linked destinations, malformed project/template versions, mismatched project/Profile identities, unknown template names, unpinned resource overrides, corrupted/missing/extra template data and changed Run input pins. Failed directory replacement preserves the original empty target. Relocated projects ignore poisoned cwd catalogs; wheel-installed reconstruction passes without a source checkout or Agent session. Coverage thresholds and release fail-closed rules remain intact.
title: feat(M1-009): add reusable project scaffold and offline user path
